description: This file acts as an entry point for the jjwg_Maps module in a SugarCRM environment. It handles different request scenarios such as running geocoding jobs via cron and passing selected records from list views to the map display, generating an HTML form to redirect requests appropriately.

classes.name: jjwg_MapsController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling actions related to jjwg_Maps, notably initiating geocoding for addresses.

methods.name: action_geocode_addresses
methods.description: Method triggered by cron to geocode addresses in the jjwg_Maps module.
